note: What a server sends to confirm a unit's spell went up a level. The header names the unit this is about. Arriving on the events channel instead, it raises the spell as well, and a client shows the new level either way.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The level the spell now stands at. A client takes any level above 5 as 5.

fields.name: pointsLeft
fields.note: How many spell points are left unspent.
